Take Control of Your Superannuation

Looking to grow your retirement wealth through real estate? With an SMSF Loan, your self-managed super fund can invest in commercial or strategic real estate while staying strictly compliant with current Australian superannuation regulations.

Following recent government reforms, SMSF property lending rules have changed. While borrowing for new residential property is restricted, commercial property borrowing remains fully available. At JM Loans, we help SMSF trustees access tailored lending solutions that align with their long-term wealth strategy—ensuring your super works harder for your future.

What Is an SMSF Loan?

An SMSF loan allows your self-managed super fund to borrow money to purchase eligible investment property. The property is held in a separate security trust (bare trust) and must meet the sole purpose test under superannuation law.

Commercial property loans are structured under a Limited Recourse Borrowing Arrangement (LRBA). This means the lender's recourse in default is strictly limited to the underlying property asset—fully protecting the other cash and investments held inside your fund.

🔐 Key Benefits of SMSF Property Investing:

  • ✅ Commercial Property Leaseback: Business owners can purchase their commercial premises through their SMSF and lease the property back to their own operating business at commercial market rates.
  • ✅ Asset Protection: The LRBA structure shields your fund’s existing cash, equity, and share assets from loan liabilities.
  • ✅ Long-Term Wealth Building: Secure high-yield commercial assets and build tangible equity for your retirement.

Residential vs. Commercial SMSF Lending (Post-2026 Rules)

FeatureResidential SMSF PropertyCommercial SMSF Loan
New LRBA BorrowingRestricted (No new borrowing allowed; outright cash purchase only)Permitted (Up to 75% – 80% LVR via LRBA)
Existing LRBA LoansGrandfathered (Contracts signed prior to 10 August 2026 remain valid)Fully active under standard LRBA rules
Tenant RulesUnrelated third-party tenants onlyCan be leased to your own business at market rate
Loan TermsN/A for new borrowing (Up to 30 years for existing grandfathered loans)Up to 25 – 30 years

Frequently Asked Questions

Can I still buy residential property through my SMSF?

Yes, but without borrowing. Under the updated government regulations, SMSFs can no longer establish a new LRBA loan to buy residential property. However, your SMSF can still purchase residential real estate if the fund has sufficient cash to buy the property outright without a loan.

What happens if I already have a residential property loan in my SMSF?

Existing residential LRBAs established or contracted prior to 10 August 2026 are grandfathered. Your existing loan arrangement remains protected and unaffected by the new legislation.

Can my business rent a commercial property owned by my SMSF?

Yes! Commercial property (Business Real Property) owned by your SMSF can be leased directly to your business, provided rent is paid at market commercial rates and structured on arms-length terms.
